wire.errors.session_host.unsupported.note: Shown to the person through AttachedSession._ensure_bound and other startup-error surfaces. No runtime was started: never imply reconnecting or an automatic retry. Preserve the literal path logs/session-host.log and product name Local Operator. Unsupported is permanent on this platform; unavailable may be temporary; refused requires inspecting the host log. No dynamic host detail is echoed.
